study: Wijekumar et al. 2009 (CompassLearning Odyssey Math, REL Mid-Atlantic, NCEE 2009-4068)
delivery_evidence: Teachers received five 'days' of CompassLearning PD delivered face-to-face: large-group sessions during the summer plus individual in-class coaching sessions throughout the school year ('The Odyssey package includes teacher professional development, offered in large group sessions during the summer and in individual in-class coaching sessions throughout the school year', PD section, ~p.33; Table 9).
test_alignment_evidence: Sole included outcome is the TerraNova CTBS Basic Battery math subtest (norm-referenced standardized test, developer-independent), a broad distal achievement measure not tailored to Odyssey; extraction test_type = standardized_independent.
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting CompassLearning Odyssey Math, a specific web-based computer math curriculum/software used ~60 min/week as a partial substitute for the regular math curriculum; control teachers used their regular curriculum with no Odyssey (Intervention/PD sections).
outcome_timing_evidence: Outcome measured at the spring posttest (Apr-May 2008), the end of the single 2007-08 school-year intervention; no post-treatment follow-up wave (extraction timepoint 'post (spring, end of the single 2007-08 school-year intervention)').
